project: Wuxia Life P123 Main Screen Martial Primary Display Narrowing
description: Display-first experience slice: reduce first-screen martial stat dominance by narrowing core stat emphasis on the main screen, while preserving full stat access and avoiding any underlying combat-system rewrite.

userStories.title: Lock first-screen stat surfaces and scope boundaries
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the current first-screen stat surfaces and scope boundaries locked before editing UI emphasis, so implementation stays on coreStats/topResources only and does not drift into tendencySummary or backend logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the current first-screen surfaces as coreStats and topResources in src/components/mainScreenModel.ts
Confirm coreStats currently includes martialPower, externalSkill, internalSkill, qinggong, constitution, and money
Confirm topResources currently includes money, constitution, and reputation
Do not modify fullStatGroups structure, event conditions, reward logic, or tendencySummary in this stage (PRD §4 Out of Scope, §7 Non-Goals)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §3 Core Problem and §4 Scope. This story is the scope lock to prevent P123 from absorbing P124.

userStories.title: Narrow coreStats to overall martial readout plus non-martial essentials
userStories.description: As a player, I want the first screen to stop showing four martial sub-stats at once, so the page reads like a life screen instead of a combat dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Main-screen coreStats no longer simultaneously show 功力, 外功, 内功, 轻功, 体魄
martialPower remains on the first screen as the overall martial readout
At least two of externalSkill, internalSkill, and qinggong are removed from first-screen coreStats and remain available only via the full stats panel
No attribute is deleted from the data model or full stats panel
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-001 and FR-1/FR-2. Keep this strictly to first-screen emphasis.

userStories.title: Reframe constitution on the first screen as survival base
userStories.description: As a player, I want 体魄 to read like survival foundation rather than one more martial specialization, so the first screen stops implying five equal combat branches.
acceptanceCriteria: Constitution's first-screen placement or adjacent wording no longer implies it is co-primary with externalSkill, internalSkill, and qinggong
If constitution remains on the first screen, its role reads closer to survival base than martial style
topResources and coreStats no longer double-amplify constitution in a way that recreates the same combat-heavy emphasis
No new attribute names, panels, or replacement systems are introduced
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-002 and FR-3. This is the smallest constitution-specific correction.

userStories.title: Preserve full stats access after first-screen narrowing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want all martial sub-stats to remain available in the full stats panel, so first-screen simplification does not silently hide important data.
acceptanceCriteria: All existing martial sub-stats remain visible in the expanded full stats panel
No full stats values or descriptions are removed solely because first-screen emphasis was reduced
MainScreenStatsPanel still opens and shows complete grouped stat data after the first-screen change
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-003 and FR-4. Do not turn this into a wording-cleanup pass for the entire panel; P125 owns that.

userStories.title: Add narrow verification for first-screen martial emphasis reduction
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want targeted verification that the first screen has less martial clutter without losing full-stat completeness, so future edits do not revert the display hierarchy.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update narrow verification covering coreStats composition after the change
Verification confirms martialPower remains first-screen visible while at least two martial sub-stats are downgraded from coreStats
Verification confirms the full stats panel still includes all existing martial sub-stats
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implements PRD §9 Verification Standard. Reuse existing UI model test patterns instead of creating a broad new test harness.
